scenario: [RFCS.19.5] binds a writer of either container ([RFCS.19.1]), and the `.dsc` is the compiler's: every message's fields in ascending field-number order, a field that is not repeated at most once, in each atom body and every message nested in one. The program gives the artefact a schema group of each lifecycle, `logical` and `ttl` ([RDSC.8.1]), a service, a two-pattern rule whose join needs a `BetaNode`, and a rule with a `call`, its `on response` continuation and an `after` follow-up, so expressions, continuations and synthesized terminals are nested in the bodies walked. `atoms` requires the artefact to hold each of those atoms. The harness ([RCTS.1.2.19], `dsc_field_order`) walks the `.dsc` from its `Dsc` message by `proto/`'s field types, after showing the walk refuses the same artefact with two fields of one atom body swapped. Path: the compiler's encoder, `dsc.encode`, through `ds.wire`'s writer. An encoder that writes a nullable slot's `nullable` (11) before its `module_id` (10) fails on `Reading.x`. The element order of a repeated field no clause orders is not pinned ([RFCS.19.5]).
rules_ds:
use default

schema SvcMethodReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.method:
    """stub"""
    response SvcMethodReply

schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    n: Int mutable
    x: Float? mutable

schema Sensor scope logical:
    id: String key

schema Alert scope logical:
    id: String key
    n: Int mutable

rule pair:
    Reading r where r.n > 0
    Sensor s where s.id == r.id
->
    emit Alert logical id: r.id n: r.n

rule ask:
    Sensor
->
    call svc.method nocooldown
        on response.code == 200:
            log info "ok"
    after 5_s:
        log info "later"
